About this item

  • 1. 3000K Warm Light - Enjoy soft warm light from the included A15 LED bulb (3000K), creating a cozy ambiance for reading or relaxation. Energy-efficient and flicker-free, this small lamp for bedroom ensures comfortable illumination day or night.
  • 2. Minimalist Design - Perfect as a bedside lamp, and this 9in height small table lamp very suitable for small space. The mini lamp can make your room appear more spacious, but does not affect its brightness, the small lamp is 680 lumens can easily illuminate the whole room.
  • 3. Easy to Use - Unbox and use in under a minute! Simply attach the lampshade to the base, screw in the pre-included LED bulb, and plug in. Because of the bedside lamps with inline button switch, there is needn't to worry about kids or pets touching it by mistake, and it is also more secure and stable.
  • 4. Comfortable Glow - The small table lamp can bring us a cozy home atmosphere, and the lamp light can fill the entire room. Because of the linen fabric shade softens the light.
  • 5. All electronic components are UL listed for access to the US market. We can sincerely promise you 100% safety of our table lamp. Welcome to contact us at any time with any request, our service team will help you in the whole shopping process, wish you a happy shopping!
